message.reasoning_content:
The image shows a Cartier Pasha watch — white dial with guilloché, Arabic numerals 12, 3, 6, 9 (well, 12, 3, 6, 9?), blue hands, "AUTOMATIC" text, cabochon crown. Actually the dial shows 12, 3, 6, 9 in a stylized font, "CARTIER" and "AUTOMATIC". This is the Cartier Pasha de Cartier 41mm automatic, reference WSPA0009 (stainless steel, steel bracelet). Or Pasha 35mm.

The watch appears large — the Pasha de Cartier 41mm with steel bracelet reference WSPA0009. Actually WSPA0009 is the 41mm steel on steel bracelet with silver guilloché dial, blue hands. Yes, that's right: Pasha de Cartier watch, 41 mm, mechanical movement with automatic winding, steel case, steel bracelet. Reference WSPA0009.

Hmm, but the dial here shows "AUTOMATIC" and has 12, 3, 6, 9 with luminescent... Actually the Pasha 41 WSPA0009 has a silver dial with Arabic numerals. There's also WSPA0010 with leather strap.

Wait — could it be the 35mm? The 35mm Pasha (WSPA0011 etc.) The photo is a close-up, can't determine scale. The 41mm Pasha has "12" and "6" large numerals. Hmm.

Let me think. The Pasha de Cartier 41mm ref 416901 / WSPA0009: steel, silver guilloché dial, blue steel hands, blue synthetic spinel cabochon crown, steel bracelet with "SmartLink" and "QuickSwitch". The dial shows 12, 3, 6, 9 and "CARTIER" and "AUTOMATIC". Yes.

Confidence ~0.6.

Bracelet material: metal (steel). Case: stainless-steel. Movement: automatic. Brand: Cartier.

Model family: Pasha de Cartier.

Reference: WSPA0009.

Hmm, but there's also the possibility of the 35mm: WSPA0011 (35mm steel bracelet). And 30mm quartz. The 41mm seems most likely given the "AUTOMATIC" and the proportion of crown.

Actually, wait — looking at the dial, the numerals 12, 3, 6, 9 and guilloché center... The 41mm Pasha has these. The 35mm also has similar. Let's go with WSPA0009.

Confidence 0.55.
